**report a *bug***
I think it's a bug.
<!-- Please ask questions on StackOverflow or the webpack Gitter (https://gitter.im/webpack/webpack). -->
<!-- Issues which contain questions or support requests will be closed. -->

**current behavior & the steps to reproduce**
I add the plugin:
`plugins: [
         /**/
        new webpack.optimize.MinChunkSizePlugin({
            minChunkSize: 10000
        }),
        /**/
    ]`
in webpack.config.js.
When I bundle my application, I got:

> /**/*/node_modules/webpack/lib/optimize/MinChunkSizePlugin.js:59
                                pair[2].integrate(pair[3], "min-size");
                                        ^

> TypeError: pair[2].integrate is not a function
at Compilation.compilation.plugin (/**/*/node_modules/webpack/lib/optimize/MinChunkSizePlugin.js:59:13)
at Compilation.applyPluginsBailResult1 (/**/*/node_modules/tapable/lib/Tapable.js:120:27)
at Compilation.seal (/**/*/node_modules/webpack/lib/Compilation.js:572:9)
at /**/*/node_modules/webpack/lib/Compiler.js:488:16
at /**/*/node_modules/tapable/lib/Tapable.js:225:11
at _addModuleChain (/**/*/node_modules/webpack/lib/Compilation.js:477:11)
at processModuleDependencies.err (/**/*/node_modules/webpack/lib/Compilation.js:448:13)
at _combinedTickCallback (internal/process/next_tick.js:67:7)
at process._tickCallback (internal/process/next_tick.js:98:9)

But if I remove the MinChunkSizePlugin, the bundle will be succeeded.

**other relevant information**

1. "webpack": "^2.3.0"
2. bundle cli: cross-env NODE_ENV=production webpack --display-modules --sort-modules-by size

**What is the current behavior?**
Webpack crashes when using `MinChunkSizePlugin` with the following error:

```
pair[2].integrate(pair[3], "min-size");
                                        ^

TypeError: pair[2].integrate is not a function
    at Compilation.compilation.plugin (/Users/eldh/Code/marketplace/node_modules/webpack/lib/optimize/MinChunkSizePlugin.js:59:13)
    at Compilation.applyPluginsBailResult1 (/Users/eldh/Code/marketplace/node_modules/webpack/node_modules/tapable/lib/Tapable.js:120:27)
    at Compilation.seal (/Users/eldh/Code/marketplace/node_modules/webpack/lib/Compilation.js:572:9)
    at /Users/eldh/Code/marketplace/node_modules/webpack/lib/Compiler.js:488:16
    at /Users/eldh/Code/marketplace/node_modules/webpack/node_modules/tapable/lib/Tapable.js:225:11
    at _addModuleChain (/Users/eldh/Code/marketplace/node_modules/webpack/lib/Compilation.js:477:11)
    at processModuleDependencies.err (/Users/eldh/Code/marketplace/node_modules/webpack/lib/Compilation.js:448:13)
    at _combinedTickCallback (internal/process/next_tick.js:67:7)
    at process._tickCallback (internal/process/next_tick.js:98:9)
```

Using the following options: `new webpack.optimize.MinChunkSizePlugin({minChunkSize: 40000}),`

**If the current behavior is a bug, please provide the steps to reproduce.**
As this seems to have been fixed in master (https://github.com/webpack/webpack/commit/915c150f3afa8a96f0d33be7c10e40fd54896faa), I'm not going to spend time on creating a repro. Still think it might be good to create this issue for other people running into this.

No crash.
